name: FUB-PB-22
summary: FUB-PB-22 (QUFUBIC) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: FUB-PB-22 acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 0.386nM at CB1 and 0.478nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.
